summary.value: Library Hotel by Library Hotel Collection is a book-themed boutique at 299 Madison Ave, at E.41st Street New York City 10017, near the New York Public Library and Grand Central. Its story is the books: guests get Access to our collection of over 6,000 books, with refreshments available 24 hours a day in our Reading Room. Trip.com guests rate it 9.3 / 10 Great 103 reviews and say “The hotel has a great location and good service”; the honest watch-out is that the facilities are old.
